# Mass Timber Connections (MTC) Solutions

> > MTC Solutions provides engineered mass timber connection systems, structural fasteners, and lifting solutions for CLT, glulam, and hybrid wood construction across North America.

MTC Solutions specializes in CCMC and ICC-ES code-approved connection systems including MEGANT beam hangers, RICON concealed connections, ASSY structural screws, and APEX fire-rated hangers. The company serves architects, engineers, contractors, and manufacturers with technical resources, installation guides, and professional support from offices in British Columbia and Montreal.

## Key Topics

- Mass Timber Connections
- CLT Construction
- MEGANT Beam Hangers
- RICON Concealed Connections
- ASSY Structural Screws
- APEX Fire-Rated Hangers
- CCMC Code Approvals
- ICC-ES Certification

- Glulam Connections
- Fire Design

- NLT and DLT Systems
- Structural Fasteners

## Connection Systems & Products

- [MTC-APEX-Overview](https://mtcsolutions.com/products/apex-overview): APEX fire-rated beam hangers manufactured in North America for mass timber
- [Yoke XL | Mass Timber Connections (MTC) Solutions](https://mtcsolutions.com/products/yoke-xl): Yoke XL lifting system for CLT, NLT, and DLT panel installation
- [45° Wedge Washer - Mass Timber Connections (MTC) Solutions](https://mtcsolutions.com/products/45-wedge-washer): 45° wedge washer for steel-to-wood connections with pre-drill jig
